description: Use this when the user asks how much snow a specific ski resort got or will get (last 24 hours, past 7 days, next 7–10 day forecast, season total, % of normal, vs last year). Accepts a resort name or slug (e.g. 'Copper', 'alta', 'Jackson Hole'). Covers ~400 US and Canada resorts. Returns a citation URL. Not for lift status, avalanche danger, or road conditions.

resort.description: Resort name or slug, e.g. 'copper-mountain' or 'Copper'

name: get_resort_snow
title: Ski resort snow report
